title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 3 mm thick, hung from a hole in the pom-pom · shown standing as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: The size is a design choice: 100 mm across. The paper bats have no measured size. Tell me a size you'd like and I'll rescale it. The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes: Bat outline traced from your photo; the hat is drawn by hand over it. Each colour goes all the way through, so the hat also shows on the back (mirrored). The brim and pom-pom stand 0.6 mm proud, like fur, so a single-colour print still shows the hat. The pom-pom is a bit bigger than the paper one (9 mm) so it can take a 3.2 mm hole for a ribbon or ornament hook. The ornament is rotated so it hangs level from that hole. Wing-claw spikes thinner than 1.2 mm were dropped because they won't print. Check: (1) does the bat shape match the paper ones (wider or narrower)? (2) is 100 mm the right size? (3) one colour or AMS multi-colour?
